display.name: AI usage: spend, tokens, work
display.description: Claude Code (claude / myclaude) and Codex: cost, tokens, cache, prompts, active time, API latency. Cost is Claude Code's own cost_usd; Codex reports tokens only. Days are IST. Built by DotFiles/config/signoz/dashboards/build.mjs.

display.name: Cost today (IST)
display.description: Claude Code cost since midnight IST (ignores the time range).

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT sum(attributes_number['cost_usd']) AS value
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp >= toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfDay(now(), 'Asia/Kolkata')) * 1000000000
  AND ts_bucket_start >= toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfDay(now(), 'Asia/Kolkata')) - 1800
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request'

display.name: Cost in range
display.description: Claude Code cost in the selected time range.

spec.name: A

display.description: Prompts typed into Claude Code and Codex.

spec.name: A

display.name: Cost per day by config
display.description: One bar per IST day, stacked by agent.config.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  toStartOfDay(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), 'Asia/Kolkata') AS ts,
  resources_string['agent.config'] AS agent_config,
  sum(attributes_number['cost_usd']) AS value
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request'
GROUP BY ts, agent_config
ORDER BY ts

display.name: Cost over time (metric)
display.description: claude_code.cost.usage: Increase / Sum by agent.config. Trails the events by up to 15 s.

display.name: Cost by model
display.description: Requests, total and average cost per model and config.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  attributes_string['model'] AS model,
  resources_string['agent.config'] AS agent_config,
  count() AS requests,
  round(sum(attributes_number['cost_usd']), 2) AS cost_usd,
  round(avg(attributes_number['cost_usd']), 4) AS avg_cost_per_request
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request'
GROUP BY model, agent_config
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

display.name: Cost by repository
display.description: Where the money goes, per repo (vcs.repository.name).

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  if(attributes_string['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(no repo)', attributes_string['vcs.repository.name']) AS repository,
  resources_string['agent.config'] AS agent_config,
  count() AS requests,
  round(sum(attributes_number['cost_usd']), 2) AS cost_usd
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request'
GROUP BY repository, agent_config
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
LIMIT 20

display.name: Models per project
display.description: Which model each project used: share of the project's requests, cost and output tokens.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  if(attributes_string['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(no repo)', attributes_string['vcs.repository.name']) AS project,
  attributes_string['model'] AS model,
  resources_string['agent.config'] AS agent_config,
  count() AS requests,
  round(100 * count() / sum(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY project, agent_config), 1) AS pct_of_project_requests,
  round(sum(attributes_number['cost_usd']), 2) AS cost_usd,
  sum(attributes_number['output_tokens']) AS output_tokens
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request'
GROUP BY project, model, agent_config
ORDER BY project, cost_usd DESC

display.name: Codex by project
display.description: Codex sends no repo name: project = last folder of the cwd on its sampling spans, joined by conversation id. client cli = Codex CLI. (unknown) = conversations with no sampling span, usually empty ones.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
-- Codex sends no repo field. Its only folder is `cwd` on the app server's
-- run_sampling_request spans; other spans in the same trace carry the
-- conversation id, which the log events have too. Project = last folder of cwd.
-- client: cli = Codex CLI (originator codex-tui), app = the ChatGPT/Codex app.
WITH conv_project AS (
  SELECT coalesce(nullIf(t.attributes_string['conversation.id'], ''),
                  nullIf(t.attributes_string['thread.id'], ''),
                  t.attributes_string['thread_id']) AS conv,
         any(s.cwd) AS cwd
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT trace_id, attributes_string['cwd'] AS cwd
    FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
    WHERE serviceName = 'codex-app-server' AND name = 'run_sampling_request'
      AND attributes_string['cwd'] != ''
      AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  ) AS s
  INNER JOIN signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 AS t ON t.trace_id = s.trace_id
  WHERE t.serviceName = 'codex-app-server' AND t.timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
    AND (t.attributes_string['conversation.id'] != '' OR t.attributes_string['thread.id'] != ''
         OR t.attributes_string['thread_id'] != '')
  GROUP BY conv
),
per_conv AS (
  SELECT
    l.attributes_string['conversation.id'] AS conv,
    if(anyIf(l.attributes_string['originator'], l.attributes_string['originator'] != '') = 'codex-tui', 'cli', 'app') AS client,
    countIf(l.attributes_string['event.name'] = 'codex.user_prompt') AS prompts,
    countIf(l.attributes_string['event.name'] = 'codex.tool_result') AS tool_calls,
    sum(toUInt64OrZero(l.attributes_string['input_token_count'])) AS input_tokens,
    sum(toUInt64OrZero(l.attributes_string['output_token_count'])) AS output_tokens,
    max(l.timestamp) AS last_ts
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 AS l
  WHERE l.timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
    AND l.ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
    AND l.resources_string['service.name'] LIKE 'codex%'
    AND l.attributes_string['conversation.id'] != ''
  GROUP BY conv
)
SELECT
  multiIf(p.cwd = '', '(unknown)', p.cwd = '/', '(no folder)', arrayElement(splitByChar('/', p.cwd), -1)) AS project,
  c.client AS client,
  count() AS conversations,
  sum(c.prompts) AS prompts,
  sum(c.tool_calls) AS tool_calls,
  sum(c.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  sum(c.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  formatDateTime(toTimeZone(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(max(c.last_ts)), 'Asia/Kolkata'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS last_used_ist
FROM per_conv AS c
LEFT JOIN conv_project AS p ON p.conv = c.conv
GROUP BY project, client
ORDER BY output_tokens DESC, conversations DESC

display.name: Usage rate by config
display.description: Per active day (IST). api_equiv_usd is Claude Code's cost_usd: what the API would charge, not what the plan bills.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  resources_string['agent.config'] AS agent_config,
  any(attributes_string['anthropic.plan']) AS plan,
  uniqExactIf(toDate(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), 'Asia/Kolkata'), attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request') AS active_days,
  countIf(attributes_string['event.name'] = 'user_prompt') AS prompts,
  countIf(attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request') AS api_requests,
  round(sumIf(attributes_number['cost_usd'], attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request'), 2) AS api_equiv_usd,
  round(api_equiv_usd / nullIf(active_days, 0), 2) AS usd_per_active_day,
  round(prompts / nullIf(active_days, 0), 1) AS prompts_per_active_day,
  round(sumIf(attributes_number['output_tokens'], attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request') / nullIf(active_days, 0)) AS output_tokens_per_day,
  round(api_equiv_usd / nullIf(prompts, 0), 2) AS usd_per_prompt
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
  AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'claude-code'
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] IN ('api_request', 'user_prompt')
GROUP BY agent_config
ORDER BY agent_config

display.name: Output tokens per 5 hours
display.description: Tumbling 5-hour IST blocks: a rough view of the plans' 5-hour usage windows (the real windows start at your first message).

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), INTERVAL 5 HOUR, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS ts,
  resources_string['agent.config'] AS agent_config,
  sum(attributes_number['output_tokens']) AS value
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request'
GROUP BY ts, agent_config
ORDER BY ts

display.name: Cost by hour of day (IST)
display.description: When each config is used.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  toHour(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), 'Asia/Kolkata') AS hour_ist,
  round(sumIf(attributes_number['cost_usd'], resources_string['agent.config'] = 'claude'), 2) AS claude_usd,
  round(sumIf(attributes_number['cost_usd'], resources_string['agent.config'] = 'myclaude'), 2) AS myclaude_usd,
  countIf(resources_string['agent.config'] = 'claude') AS claude_requests,
  countIf(resources_string['agent.config'] = 'myclaude') AS myclaude_requests
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request'
GROUP BY hour_ist
ORDER BY hour_ist

display.name: Rate-limit hits
display.description: Each 'would exceed your rate limit' error, with that config's usage in the 5 hours before it: what the plan allowed.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
-- Each rate-limit error, with what that config used in the 5 hours before it:
-- an empirical view of the plan's 5-hour allowance.
WITH hits AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS hit_ts,
         resources_string['agent.config'] AS agent_config,
         attributes_string['anthropic.plan'] AS plan,
         attributes_string['model'] AS model
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
    AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
    AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_error'
    AND attributes_string['error'] LIKE '%rate limit%'
),
reqs AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS ts,
         resources_string['agent.config'] AS agent_config,
         attributes_number['cost_usd'] AS cost,
         attributes_number['output_tokens'] AS output_tokens
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} - 5 * 3600 * 1000000000 AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
    AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 5 * 3600 - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
    AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request'
)
SELECT
  fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(h.hit_ts) AS hit_at,
  h.agent_config AS agent_config,
  h.plan AS plan,
  h.model AS model,
  countIf(r.ts BETWEEN h.hit_ts - 5 * 3600 * 1000000000 AND h.hit_ts) AS requests_prev_5h,
  round(sumIf(r.cost, r.ts BETWEEN h.hit_ts - 5 * 3600 * 1000000000 AND h.hit_ts), 2) AS api_equiv_usd_prev_5h,
  sumIf(r.output_tokens, r.ts BETWEEN h.hit_ts - 5 * 3600 * 1000000000 AND h.hit_ts) AS output_tokens_prev_5h
FROM hits AS h
INNER JOIN reqs AS r ON r.agent_config = h.agent_config
GROUP BY hit_at, agent_config, plan, model
ORDER BY hit_at DESC
LIMIT 30

display.name: Prompt cache by config
display.description: cache_hit_pct = cache reads / all input. A drop means something keeps breaking the cache.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  resources_string['agent.config'] AS agent_config,
  sum(attributes_number['cache_read_tokens']) AS cache_read,
  sum(attributes_number['input_tokens'] + attributes_number['cache_creation_tokens']) AS uncached_input,
  sum(attributes_number['output_tokens']) AS output,
  round(100 * cache_read / nullIf(cache_read + uncached_input, 0), 1) AS cache_hit_pct
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request'
GROUP BY agent_config

display.name: API latency by model
display.description: p50/p95 request duration and time to first token (ms).

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  attributes_string['model'] AS model,
  count() AS requests,
  round(quantile(0.5)(attributes_number['duration_ms'])) AS p50_ms,
  round(quantile(0.95)(attributes_number['duration_ms'])) AS p95_ms,
  round(quantile(0.5)(attributes_number['ttft_ms'])) AS p50_ttft_ms,
  round(quantile(0.95)(attributes_number['ttft_ms'])) AS p95_ttft_ms
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'api_request'
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY requests DESC
